newsitem.title: USA: CBOT forums to discuss changes to muni contract.
newsitem.headline: CBOT forums to discuss changes to muni contract.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade targeted two forums to discuss possible changes to its municipal bond futures contract, an exchange official said Thursday.

Steve Sural, director of the CBOT's financial markets group, said a forum will be held Oct 16 in Chicago and Oct 22 in New York City to discuss proposed changes to the contract based on an index of 40 bonds.
Prior to the meetings, he said the proposals will be communicated to the trading floor.
Last month, CBOT officials said several proposals were being targeted, including an electronic system for displaying real-time dealer bids and asks for bonds in the contract's underlying index.

Other proposals were increasing the minimum size of the bond issues in the index to as high as $75 million to $100 million from the current minimum of $50 million, expanding the evaluation time for determining whether to delete bonds from the index due to illiquidity to 20 to 30 days from the current 15 days, and allowing deleted bonds to return to the index as long as they continue to meet index criteria.
Sural said while the proposals presented at the forums will not be final, they will be more fleshed out.
CBOT asks those interested in attending to call Amy Casey at 312-435-4687.
